title: declare_conflict
description: The active player declares a conflict (3.2): the contested ring, taken from the unclaimed ring pool, the type of the conflict, the attacked province of an opponent and the ready characters declared as attackers. `evaded_ids` are the characters of the defending player chosen with covert: the engine does not check the covert keyword.

ring.description: Contested ring, from the unclaimed ring pool.

attacker_ids.description: Ready characters of the player declared as attackers.

evaded_ids.description: Characters of the defending player chosen with covert.
